title: City Council — November 21, 2023 Work Session, CDRA, Business Meeting
motion: MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to APPROVE Ordinance 405. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell. Council Member Birrell appreciated Staff and the history behind having Master Plans. She has voiced her concerns regarding the need to put safety as the number one element within the Transportation Master Plan and although there are many elements she appreciated; she was not supportive of approval at this time. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton-Aye, Council Member Newell-Aye, Council Member Birrell-Nay, and Mayor Pro Temp Bracken-Aye
